services.name: Commerce to ERP integration
services.scope: Build the integration between Adobe Commerce and your client's ERP on Adobe's Commerce integration starter kit in App Builder: map order, customer, product and stock fields, deploy the actions for each, subscribe to the Commerce events, connect the actions to the ERP's APIs, set retries and test. Where a prebuilt connector on Adobe Exchange fits the ERP, install and configure it instead.
services.adobe_quote: Integrating Adobe Commerce with your enterprise resource planning (ERP), order management system (OMS), or customer relationship management (CRM) is now easier with Adobe Commerce integration starter kit.

source.title: Adobe Developer: Install Adobe Commerce integration starter kit

connection_how: We will connect Adobe Commerce and your ERP on Adobe's Commerce integration starter kit, which runs in Adobe Developer App Builder, or with a prebuilt connector from Adobe Exchange where one fits your ERP. Commerce will send order, customer and product events to the integration, which will call your ERP's APIs, and stock, price and order status changes from your ERP will be written back to Commerce. Where Commerce needs an answer at once, such as taxes or order totals, a webhook will ask your ERP before checkout goes on.
product_facts: The partner builds this on Adobe's Commerce integration starter kit, which runs in Adobe Developer App Builder, or installs a prebuilt connector from Adobe Exchange where one fits the ERP. Commerce sends order, customer and product events through Adobe I/O Events to App Builder actions that call the ERP's APIs, and the ERP's stock, price and order status changes come back to Commerce through its APIs. Webhooks let Commerce ask the ERP for an answer at once, such as taxes or order totals, before it goes on.
Orders placed in Commerce reach your client's ERP without re-entry, and the ERP's stock, prices and order status reach Commerce.

Integrating Adobe Commerce with your enterprise resource planning (ERP), order management system (OMS), or customer relationship management (CRM) is now easier with Adobe Commerce integration starter kit.

Your platform will keep shopper accounts, cart, checkout and orders, and we will build the custom integration that hands shoppers from the new storefront to them.
product_facts: Adobe's Commerce Salesforce Connector, built on App Builder, syncs catalog and price data from Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2C into Commerce Optimizer on a schedule or on demand. The other platform keeps shopper accounts, cart, checkout and orders; joining them to the storefront is a custom build with API Mesh, App Builder or direct APIs, and Adobe's checkout starter kit for Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a reference to adapt.
Your client keeps its commerce platform for orders and gets Adobe's search, merchandising and storefront on top of it.
syncs catalog and price data from Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2C into Adobe Commerce Optimizer
The host commerce platform remains responsible for shopper accounts, cart, checkout, and order processing.
Integration with the host platform is a custom implementation, using API Mesh, App Builder, direct APIs, or a combination of these tools.
Use it as a reference implementation and adapt it to your storefront; it is not a generic, out-of-the-box connector.
Businesses where a third-party system manages the cart and checkout lifecycle.

services.name: Storefront on Edge Delivery for Commerce Optimizer
owner: Commerce Optimizer + AEM Sites with Edge Delivery Services
services.scope: Create your client's storefront project on Edge Delivery Services with Adobe's Site Creator, point it at the Optimizer instance, catalog view and locale, build the product detail, search and category pages from Adobe's ready-made storefront parts, brand them and test them against the agreed pages.
services.adobe_quote: This guide walks you through setting up a storefront for your Adobe Commerce Optimizer instance using Adobe Edge Delivery Services.

source.title: Experience League: Set up your storefront (Commerce Optimizer)

connection_how: We will build your storefront on Edge Delivery Services with Adobe's Commerce storefront for Commerce Optimizer: its ready-made storefront parts will take catalog, search and recommendations from Optimizer, while your commerce platform keeps cart, checkout and accounts.
product_facts: Adobe's Commerce storefront on Edge Delivery Services runs on Commerce Optimizer: its ready-made storefront parts ask Optimizer for catalog, search and recommendations, while the commerce platform behind it keeps cart, checkout and accounts. The storefront comes with the Optimizer package, not with Optimizer Headless.
Your client's shoppers browse and search a storefront on Edge Delivery Services, fed by Optimizer's catalog views and merchandising.
This guide walks you through setting up a storefront for your Adobe Commerce Optimizer instance using Adobe Edge Delivery Services.
Drop-ins are licensed exclusively for use with Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service and Adobe Commerce Optimizer.
Commerce Storefront powered by Edge Delivery Services is not included in Adobe Commerce Optimizer Headless.

services.name: Product images from AEM Assets with Product Visuals
services.scope: Configure AEM Assets for Commerce Optimizer to turn on Product Visuals, agree with your client's DAM owner how product images carry their SKU and are approved, and check that approved images show on the storefront.
services.adobe_quote: The integration matches assets to products by SKU.

source.title: Experience League: Adobe Commerce Optimizer integrations

connection_how: We will turn on Product Visuals so your product images in AEM Assets reach Commerce Optimizer, matched to products by SKU, and updates reach your storefronts without manual re-uploads.
product_facts: Product Visuals lets your client manage product images in AEM Assets for Commerce Optimizer: it matches assets to products by SKU, and updates reach the storefronts without manual re-uploads.
Your client's product images are approved and kept in AEM Assets, and the storefront shows the latest ones.
Product Visuals lets you manage product images through Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets.
The integration matches assets to products by SKU.
Updates flow through Adobe's integration services so storefronts reflect the latest media without manual re-uploads.

services.name: Commerce database connection for Commerce Intelligence
services.scope: Connect your client's Commerce database to Commerce Intelligence through an SSH tunnel, with a read-only database user and the host key checked, choose the first tables to sync and check the first sync.
services.adobe_quote: As the Adobe Commerce database is based on MySQL, you can connect it to Commerce Intelligence through a direct connection , cPanel , or via an SSH tunnel .

source.title: Experience League: Connect your Adobe Commerce database

connection_how: We will connect your Adobe Commerce database to Commerce Intelligence through an SSH tunnel, the method Adobe recommends as the most secure, and sync the tables your reports need into its data warehouse.
product_facts: Commerce Intelligence connects to the Adobe Commerce database, which is MySQL, through a direct connection, cPanel or an SSH tunnel, the method Adobe recommends as the most secure, and copies the chosen tables into its data warehouse for reports.
Your client's teams report on orders, customers and products from Commerce without exports or spreadsheets.
As the Adobe Commerce database is based on MySQL, you can connect it to Commerce Intelligence through a direct connection , cPanel , or via an SSH tunnel .
The SSH method is recommended because it is the most secure.

Adobe Commerce Intelligence means the On-demand Service business intelligence platform that can be purchased as part of a bundled offering or as an upgrade to the Base Package and that includes data extraction, data warehousing, data analysis, and data visualization capabilities.

services.name: Salesforce data into Commerce Intelligence
services.scope: Connect your client's Salesforce to Commerce Intelligence with a Salesforce user that can read the agreed objects, choose the tables to sync and join them to the Commerce data for the agreed reports.
services.adobe_quote: Connecting your Salesforce data enables a range of analyses, from scoring and optimizing leads to hitting your goals for converted opportunities.

source.title: Experience League: Salesforce in Commerce Intelligence

connection_how: We will connect your Salesforce to Commerce Intelligence so its data sits in the data warehouse beside your Commerce data.
product_facts: Commerce Intelligence's Salesforce integration brings your client's Salesforce data into its data warehouse beside the Commerce data, for analyses from lead scoring to converted opportunities.
Your client's reports put Salesforce leads and opportunities next to Commerce orders.
SaaS integrations are services like Google Adwords , Salesforce , and Zendesk .
Connecting your Salesforce data enables a range of analyses, from scoring and optimizing leads to hitting your goals for converted opportunities.

services.name: Google Ads cost data into Commerce Intelligence
services.scope: Connect your client's Google Ads account to Commerce Intelligence, check that campaign tracking on the storefront ties orders to campaigns, and build the report of campaign cost against the lifetime value of the customers each campaign brought.
services.adobe_quote: you can measure campaign ROI by marrying your advertising cost and the customer lifetime value (CLV) of users acquired from your campaigns.
